name: SetCommunicationProcessingSchedule
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork through LLD02 SettingDefinitionRegistry; settings participate without nested receipt/commit
authoritative_reads: active job configuration snapshots for non-mutation only
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> insert command_receipt -> setting writes -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: material changes increment setting revisions; no-change returns NO_CHANGE; existing job snapshots unchanged
post_commit_work: scheduler recomputes next eligible ordinary run; no Deep Scan/backfill is started by setting change
